series_datasheet_esr_limits.note: The part spec sheet rates ESR at 100 kHz/25 C.  Series page 4 plots ESR vs frequency only for A720V477M002 (2 V) and A720V226M035 (35 V), with no tabulated values, and publishes no ESR-vs-temperature and no ESR-vs-bias curve.  End of life is bounded, not a curve: at the endurance limit the bank ESR doubles, which is still far above the P0 <= 0.07 mOhm ask.
